# PPTX Test Fixtures

All `.pptx` files in this directory are synthetic test fixtures generated by
`scripts/generate-pptx-fixtures.mjs`.

## Provenance & Licensing

- Generator: `scripts/generate-pptx-fixtures.mjs`
- Generator library: `pptxgenjs@4.0.1` (MIT licensed)
- Additional tools: `@zip.js/zip.js` (BSD-3-Clause)
- License: MIT (same as repository)
- Contains no private, personal, proprietary, or copyrighted documents
- Contains no remote network assets; all images are generated 16x16 PNG byte arrays embedded locally

## Fixture Inventory

- `text-two-slides.pptx`: Two slides with bold titles and italic Chinese text for single-slide and cross-slide native text selection.
- `table-image.pptx`: 2x2 table and embedded generated PNG image with caption text.
- `chart.pptx`: Slide containing an embedded chart and ordinary selectable label.
- `large-120-slides.pptx`: 120 slides with lightweight text to test windowed DOM virtualization and scrolling.
- `image-only.pptx`: Slide containing only an image without any selectable text to test Ask suppression.
- `external-links.pptx`: Contains a safe HTTPS link (`https://example.com/`) and a dangerous javascript pseudo-protocol link (`javascript:...`).
- `external-media.pptx`: Post-processed OOXML archive containing an `External` image relationship target (`https://example.invalid/dsa-pptx-probe.png`) designed to verify fail-closed relationship security gating before rendering.
